observation.visible_scene: A bright dance studio with white walls, a dark ceiling with track spotlights, an air-conditioning unit on the upper-left wall, a light wood floor, and a floor-to-ceiling mirror along the right wall. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black floral sleeveless top, a black skirt with red trim, red leg warmers and red shoes, stands with her back to the camera facing the mirror; her front-facing reflection appears in the mirror. The camera viewpoint and background fixtures remain fixed throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: At the start (t=0–0.12s) she holds a flexed pose with both elbows bent and fists/hands raised to about head/shoulder height; the mirror reflection reproduces the same pose.
From t≈0.16s to t≈0.24s she extends both arms upward, opening her hands and raising them above her head.
From t≈0.28s to t≈0.64s her arms stay fully stretched overhead with fingers forming an open gesture, body largely still in a wide stance.
From t≈0.68s to t≈1.04s she bends her elbows, drawing the raised hands down and outward to roughly head level with fingers splayed, holding a new upper-body pose.

From t≈1.08s to t≈1.60s she maintains the bent-arm, hands-at-head pose with small adjustments of the hands and a slight sway/weight shift of the torso and hips; the reflection tracks all of these changes.
Her foot positions remain essentially planted in a wide stance; the visible motion is concentrated in the arms and upper body, not in translation across the floor.
outside_clip_unknowns: The choreography or pose that precedes t=0 and follows t=1.6s is not shown.
Whether the arm movements are part of a larger dance sequence, and any accompanying music or cues, is unseen.
uncertain_details: The exact intended hand/finger gesture is not identifiable beyond its visible shape.
Minor torso rotation between frames is small and could be weight shift rather than a deliberate turn.
The figure in the mirror is a reflection of the same dancer, not a second person.
